sources.citation: Denz, Pawlowski, Reichert, Towards apparent convergence in asymptotically safe quantum gravity, EPJC 78, 336 (2018), arXiv:1612.07315
sources.note: Systematic Euclidean fluctuation/vertex expansion through four-graviton function; UV fixed point and IR trajectories. No frozen evidence of an explicit six-direction UV-to-RQIR sensitivity Jacobian with propagated uncertainty.

sources.citation: Pawlowski, Traenkle, Effective action and black hole solutions in asymptotically safe quantum gravity, Phys. Rev. D 110, 086011 (2024)
sources.note: Uses existing fluctuation-flow data, integrates fully momentum-dependent four-point flow at physical cutoff, reconstructs effective action/form factors and continues to Lorentzian black-hole equations. No explicit derivative of six RQIR outputs with respect to UV critical-surface coordinates.

sources.citation: Assant, Litim, Reichert, Spectral Functions of Lorentzian Quantum Gravity, arXiv:2606.19321 (2026)
sources.note: Lorentzian graviton spectral functions interpolate from classical GR to an asymptotically safe UV fixed point; effective action/form factors are extracted to quadratic order in curvature. Higher-point closure and six-direction Jacobian are not supplied by the frozen evidence.

sources.citation: Del Porro et al., Impact of Quantum Gravity on the UV Sensitivity of Extremal Black Holes, Fortschritte der Physik (2026), DOI:10.1002/prop.70101
sources.note: Genuine fixed-point/eigendirection/separatrix-to-one-IR-Wilson-coefficient bridge in a specific essential six-derivative truncation. It is not a six-direction RQIR map; reported coefficient magnitude is strongly prescription/regulator dependent although its sign is stable in the two reported treatments.

sources.citation: Knorr, Asymptotically (un)safe scattering amplitudes from scratch: a deep dive into the IR jungle, arXiv:2602.21285 (2026)
sources.note: Explicit scattering calculation in a simplified setting: fixed point alone does not ensure amplitude boundedness and derivative/RG-improvement approximations can fail for momentum-dependent Wilson-coefficient reconstruction. Used as an anti-shortcut guard, not as completion evidence.

lineage_policy: Node support may be unioned only among rows with the same lineage label. Cross-lineage unions are diagnostic only and cannot establish same-realization closure.
